Geometric mean durations over all four trials for both percepts. In each trial, the global percept was perceived over longer periods than the local one. Importantly, durations do not differ significantly across trials for either percept. Error bars represent ±SEM. Figure S3. Control analysis using the median percept durations instead of the geometric mean.
